meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 代码编辑完成后自动检查注释；发现异常会返回阻断性反馈，Claude 需先修复或解释被标记的注释再继续。
howto.when: 在成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑操作后，若检查器报出注释警告即触发。

say.text: 先修复检查器标出的注释问题。
say.note: Claude 会按反馈修改对应注释。

say.text: 解释一下这条注释为什么被标记。
say.note: Claude 会结合检查器反馈说明原因。

say.text: 在继续之前，先处理注释警告。
say.note: Claude 会暂停后续操作直到处理完成。

howto.what_en: After an edit-like operation (apply_patch, write, edit, etc.), the plugin inspects code comments. If it flags a problem, Claude receives blocking feedback and must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a successful edit-like tool call (apply_patch, write, edit, multi_edit, multiedit) produces comment-checker warning feedback.

say_en.text: Please fix the comments the checker flagged.
say_en.note: Claude will update the flagged comments accordingly.

say_en.text: Explain why this comment was flagged.
say_en.note: Claude will use the checker feedback to explain.

say_en.text: Handle the comment warnings before continuing.
say_en.note: Claude will pause until the warnings are processed.
